breadth.description: Print one callable's direct callers and callees, resolved against a project and its Nx dependencies.

depth.description: Print every call stack above and below one callable, resolved against a project and its Nx dependencies.

gate.description: Fail a project whose call stacks broke the depth or breadth limits it is held to, resolved against the project and its Nx dependencies.

trace.description: Trace a project's call stacks with callidescope, following its Nx dependencies.
